title: Forms, validation and the v-model contract

videos.script:
The planner can tick sessions off. It cannot add one. {{form}} Today it gets a form, and a form is where a front end meets a person typing, so it is where most of the small mistakes live.

You start with every kind of field. A date, a select, a number, a set of radio buttons, and what each one hands back. {{modifiers}} Then three modifiers, trim, number and lazy, and the bug each one saves you from.

{{field}} Then a field component, with its label and its error in one place, joined to the parent with defineModel. And lesson three's writable computed finally meets a field.

{{validate}} Then validation. A computed that says what is wrong, and a decision about when to say it.

{{a11y}} Then the part most forms forget. An error a screen reader can hear, wired with three attributes.

{{submit}} Then the submit itself, in four steps, and what to reset afterwards. {{planner}} And the planner adds a guitar session on the twenty fourth, and the week's total moves.
